# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Jonas is a tow-haired, homely man with inspired eyes and an intellectual brow hidden on weekdays by roughly-falling hair. Although considered plain by some, he does not look so homely by moonlight, and when radiant in his happiness on his wedding day, nobody thinks him plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P13](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0013), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Jonas is earnest, tender, true, and decisive, possessing every quality a minister ought to have. He enjoys laughing, joking, and social company. He provides thoughtful advice to those who are perplexed and is deeply devoted to Philippa Gordon.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## History

Jonas graduated from Redmond College and later attended St. Columbia to prepare for the ministry. While staying in a summer boarding location, he became acquainted with Philippa Gordon, going fishing, boating, and walking on the sands with her. After preaching an earnest sermon at the local village church, he deeply moved Philippa, who realized her love for him. He offered her guidance when she felt perplexed and proposed marriage to her. Despite initial opposition from Philippa's mother regarding his modest plans, Jonas visited her family at Mount Holly and won their affection. Upon graduating from St. Columbia, he married Philippa in Bolingbroke with Anne Shirley as bridesmaid. Following their wedding trip, he settled with his bride on Patterson Street to minister at a local mission church in the slums.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P14](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0014), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)_
